note: Every source of contact details the Atlas holds, and the licence each is passed on under. A harvested source has its rows under data/contacts/<id>/<CC>.json.gz; `own` and `wikidata` are read from data/provider-emails.json and data/provider-contacts.json. `group` keeps share-alike data apart from the rest all the way to the browser. `rank` orders values where two sources give one: lower first. A source may be added only with its licence read on its own page.
